title: Europe Must Stand with Canada Against Trump
author: @plegrain

Europe Must Stand with Canada Against Trump

Aug 27, 2026

Philippe Legrain

Rather than keeping their heads down as US President Donald Trump wages another trade war with Canada, European leaders must recognize that they could be next. Like Canada, the European Union is a middle power whose future prosperity and security will depend on solidarity with economic peers.

LONDON—Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s widely acclaimed speech at Davos earlier this year remains the talk of diplomats worldwide. Carney argued that middle powers must act together to avoid becoming victims of predatory superpowers, and he has lived by his words, duly standing with his European allies as US President Donald Trump threatened to invade Greenland, a Danish territory.
